# Character enrichment sources

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:

- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT

  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 義# (ceremony) + 人 person (→ human agency) → conduct a *ceremony* → *rules* → *follow*; *obey* (good standards) (← follow/obey rules). *Matters* is a borrowed meaning.
度也。从人義聲。
As per 雋# (well-proportioned) + 人 person → handsome (and talented/outstanding) person → *conspicuous/outstanding person*; *outstanding*; *excellent*.
As per 農# (soft and sticky) + 人 person → two people figuratively stuck together in a lasting, intimate relation → *you*; *I*. Compare 你/儞.
儃何也。从人亶聲。

As per 意# (contained in the heart). *One hundred million* is a borrowed meaning. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one (although in this case too the original sense eventually changed).
安也。从人𢡃聲。
As per 敬# (stiff; upright) + 人 person (→ human agency) → cause another to go stiff/upright in admonishing or warning → *admonish*; *warn*.
戒也。从人敬聲。《春秋傳》曰：“儆宮。”
慧也。从人瞏聲。
合市也。从人、會，會亦聲。
As per 僉# (assemble) + 人 person (→ human agency) → be *thrifty*/economical in assembling (= collecting) goods → *economy*; *frugal*.
約也。从人僉聲。
As per 詹# (bear a burden) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *bear* a *burden*.
何也。从人詹聲。
賓# guest + 人 person (→ human agency) → *entertain guests*; *assist by leading/guiding*.
導也。从人賓聲。
As per 需# (soft) + 人 person → person of soft/gentle demeanor → culture; cultured; person of culture; scholar → *Confucianism*.
柔也。術士之偁。从人需聲。
壽# long span + 人 person → *companion* (of long duration).
翳也。从人壽聲。
As per 齊# (align) + 人 person → *companion* with whom one is actually or figuratively aligned.
等輩也。从人齊聲。《春秋傳》曰：“吾儕小人。”
A variant form of 擬 imitate, replacing 手 with 人 person (→ human agency) → *mimic/imitate* (another person) → *draw an analogy*.
僭也。一曰相疑。从人从疑。
盡# use up; exhaust + 人 person (→ human agency) → use up *everything*/*all* → *leave as is* (← use up and abandon).

盡.example: 尽力 → 盡力; 尽管 → 儘管
盡.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.

entries.text: As per 夢#: (obscure) → *evanescent*, *fleeting* or *ephemeral* → *empty*; *vain*. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one.
舞# dance + 人 person (for emphasis/clarification) → *dance*.
As per 寧# (settle) + 人 person → person settled/immobile on account of being too *weak* to act → *troubled*.
賞# bestow; reward + 人 person (→ human agency) → bestow compensation → *compensate*; *indemnify* (a person) → *reparation*; *atonement*.
還也。从人賞聲。
長壯儠巤也。从人巤聲。《春秋傳》曰：“長儠者相之。”
畾# as described in 疊 (pile) + 人 person → pile objects into a lumpy human shape → dummy → *puppet*. Compare 傀. *Defeat*, *weaken* and *come down in the world* are borrowed meanings.
相敗也。从人畾聲。讀若雷。
賣也。从人𧷏聲。
行皃。从人麃聲。《詩》曰：“行人儦儦。”

As per 憂# (deliberate movement) → *graceful*; *flexible*; *gentle* (← move gracefully, with great deliberation) → *excel*; *superior* (← graceful motion) → *kind*; *tender*. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying a nuance that dropped from the original one.
饒也。从人憂聲。一曰倡也。

As per 諸# (compilation): → *keep in reserve*; *save*; *store* (up). Also, *profit* and *profit-making* (← surplus money). Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying the sense "compilation" that dropped from 諸.
偫也。从人諸聲。
As per 毚# (pile) + 人 person (→ human agency) → create a pile → *be mixed/disorderly* (← uneven pile) → *stupid* (← stupidity in creating an uneven pile).
儳互，不齊也。从人毚聲。
青黑繒縫白色也。从黑攸聲。
As per 麗# (neatly aligned) + 人 person → alignment of persons → (married) *couple*; *companion(s)*; *line up*; *form a set*.
棽儷也。从人麗聲。
最也。从人贊聲。
As per 難# (grill over a fire) + 人 person (→ human agency) → conduct a *fire ceremony to drive out evil spirits*.
行人節也。从人難聲。《詩》曰：“佩玉之儺。”
倜儻也。从人黨聲。
As per 嚴# (rugged) + 人 person → *solemn*; *majestic* (← figuratively rugged individual). Also, *stern* and *firm*.
昂頭也。从人嚴聲。一曰好皃。
垂皃。从人纍聲。一曰嬾解。
A variant of 人 person, like 人 suggesting people in mutable interaction → *person*; *human figure*.
仁人也。古文奇字人也。象形。孔子曰：“在人下，故詰屈。”凡儿之屬皆从儿。
一# (fullness) + 儿 person → raise a prisoner's/captive's head fully (to shave it in punishment) → *thrust high/tall*.
高而上平也。从一在人上。讀若敻。茂陵有兀桑里。
The relevant seal inscription form shows a human figure running in chasing or being chased (compare 夭). *Consent*; *permit*, *sincere* and *peaceful* are borrowed meanings.
信也。从儿㠯聲。
The relevant seal inscription form is a depiction of a slender *hairpin* (compare 妻 and 參), one thrust deep into the hair. Distinguish 兂 from 无 and 旡.
首笄也。从人，匕象簪形。凡兂之屬皆从兂。

As per 兀# (head) + a horizontal line → *head* → *origin*; *cause*; *raw material*; *capital*; *prime element* (← head as source and beginning; compare 頭) → *former* (← prior ← original). 元 was devised to replace 兀 after the latter lost its original connection with the head.
始也。从一从兀。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines 儿 person + a large head → large-headed person extending the arms in prayer. *Elder brother* is a borrowed meaning. Note how the original connection with prayer is preserved in 呪 and in 祝.
長也。从儿从口。凡兄之屬皆从兄。

As per 𠫓# as described in 育 (fetus filling then passing through the birth canal) + 儿 person (for emphasis/clarification) → fetus filling the birth canal → *fill* → *fulfill*; *satisfy* → *apply*; *allot*; *allocate* (← satisfy a requirement in need of being fulfilled) → *assign* (← allocate).
長也。高也。从儿，育省聲。

A depiction of animal bones and tortoise shells baked in divination rites, showing the curving cracks/splits that were scrutinized in *fortunetelling* → *sign*; *indication*; *omen* → *symptom*. *Trillion* is a borrowed meaning.
凶# terrible + 儿 person → *terrible*/fearful person or human-like apparition → *cruel*; *fearsome* → *fear*.
擾恐也。从人在凶下。《春秋傳》曰：“曹人兇懼。”

The relevant seal inscription form combines 儿# person + 之 (forward motion) → advance in small increments, the feet in close adherence → *go ahead*; *advance* → *tip*; *previous*; *the late*; *ancestor*; *first of all*; *prior*; *the future*.
前進也。从儿从之。凡先之屬皆从先。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines an abbreviated form# of 兄 (extend the arms) + 火 fire → extend the arms in holding up a torch → (radiant) *light*; *shine*; *ray*; *beam*; *flash*; *glimmer*; *glitter*; *glare*; *sparkle*.
明也。从火在人上，光明意也。
The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows a helmeted head# + 儿 person → helmeted warrior, stretched to full height (compare 亟). *Overcome* and *conquer* are borrowed meanings.
肩也。象屋下刻木之形。凡克之屬皆从克。

剋.explanation: The standard lists the relationship but explicitly does not simplify 剋 pronounced kēi when it means scolding or hitting. 克 also remains unchanged in ordinary words meaning overcome/gram.
剋.example: 克服 → 克服; 剋人 (kēi, scold/hit) remains 剋
剋.unchangedSense: 克服 and inherited uses of 克; 剋 read kēi for scolding/hitting
剋.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 八# split right and left + 兄 (extend the arms) → extend the arms in stripping away a captive's clothes and *exchange* them for prisoner's garb.
說也。从儿㕣聲。

Abbreviated form# of 奐 (draw a fetus out of/away from the womb) + 儿 person (→ human agency) → assist the escape of a fetus from its mother by drawing it out of/away from the birth canal → *escape/be rescued from* → *avoid*; *evade*; *elude* → *exempt* (← escape from an obligation).
A depiction of a *rabbit/hare*, a fast animal. 兔 is an older form of this character.

The relevant seal inscription form shows, as depicted in 思, a profusion of fine bones in fontanels (open spaces in an infant's skull over which the skull bones eventually fuse) + 儿 person → *infant*; (very young) *child*.
孺子也。从儿，象小兒頭囟未合。
兂# (hairpin penetrating the hair) doubled → *deep penetration* of a tight space by a *sharp and slender* object.
朁朁，銳意也。从二兂。
獸名。象踞，後其尾形。兔頭與㲋頭同。凡兔之屬皆从兔。
A depiction of a *single-horned beast*, identified by some sources as a rhinoceros.
An abbreviated form# of 冑 (armor, including a helmet) + 儿 person → helmeted figure → *helmet*; *headgear*.
兜鍪，首鎧也。从𠑹，从皃省。皃象人頭也。
進也。从二先。贊从此。闕。
As per 克# (stretch) (doubled) → stretch to one's full height in watchfulness (compare 企) → *be watchful/discreet*.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character depicts a soft, yielding sack into which goods are placed (compare 襄) → *enter*; *put/allow in*; *let in*; *take in*; *hold/accommodate*; *contain*; *carry/stock* (goods); *go/come in*. *Need/require* is a borrowed meaning.
内也。象从上俱下也。凡入之屬皆从入。
入也。从口，自外而入也。

An abbreviated form# of 侖 neat assemblage/alignment + 王 (ruler who spans heaven and earth, bringing them into harmony) → ruler who arranges everything *fully*/perfectly → *full*; *perfect*; *all*; *entirely*; *completely*; *utterly* → *in truth*; *indeed*.
A depiction of a measuring device with long arms aligned on *both* sides → *form a pair* → *unit of weight*; (Edo period) *unit of money*. *Counter for cars/tanks* is a borrowed meaning.
二十四銖爲一兩。从一；㒳，平分，亦聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is 舟# boat + an element combining a cover and shavings (compare 少) → *remove*/scoop out wood from a log to create a dugout canoe. *Answer affirmatively* is a borrowed meaning.

Two curved lines bending away from each other, suggesting the idea of splitting away to right and left → *divide/part from* right and left. *Eight* is either a borrowed meaning or may be regarded as having been considered the single-digit number divisible by two the greatest number of times.
別也。象分別相背之形。凡八之屬皆从八。
Originally, 八 split right and left + 口# mouth/hole (→ space) → *open* space in which (divided groups of) people gather → *public* → *fair*; *official*; *governmental*.
平分也。从八从厶。(音司。)八猶背也。韓非曰：背厶爲公。
A depiction of a tall mound that curves in stretching at length. *Six* is a borrowed meaning.
《易》之數，陰變於六，正於八。从入从八。凡六之屬皆从六。
Effectively, a variant form of 乎 exclamation → *exclamatory, euphonic or emphatic particle*.
語所稽也。从丂，八象气越亏也。凡兮之屬皆从兮。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 廾# (pair of hands holding up/out an object in raising it high in offering; compare 具) + an object → serve; offer → *together*; *with*; *share* → *plural/humble suffix*.
同也。从廿、廾。凡共之屬皆从共。
The relevant seal inscription form is 斤# ax + 廾 pair of hands → spread the hands over the long handle of an ax-like weapon (compare 父) → (armed) *soldier* → *army*; *weapon*.
械也。从廾持斤，并力之皃。
Originally, a depiction of a square or rectangular winnow. The relevant bronzeware inscription form appends 几# desk/table. *That* is a borrowed meaning.

The relevant seal inscription form combines an abbreviated form of 鼎 tripod kettle/cauldron + an abbreviated form of 共# (act jointly in making an offering) → act together to *equip* a vessel for offering → *equipment*; *implement*; *tool*. Also, *means* and *ability* (← have the means/ability to equip). In 颶, 具 appears in a variant form.
共置也。从廾，从貝省。古以貝爲貨。

The relevant seal inscription form combines an abbreviated form# of 侖 (neat, logical assemblage of bound records) + 丌 a stand/table → heavy assemblage of records on a stand/table → *code*; *tome* (← record of weighty rules and laws) → *ceremony* (← ceremony conducted according to written rules).
五帝之書也。从冊在丌上，尊閣之也。莊都說，典，大冊也。

The relevant seal inscription form shows two ears of grain + a hand → storehouse encompassing grain that has been gathered then stored/put away → *combine*; *unite*; *serve/perform concurrently*; *simultaneous*. *Unable to do* is a borrowed meaning. In derivative characters, 兼 may also appear in the form seen for example in 嗛, 歉 or 賺.
并也。从又持秝。兼持二禾，秉持一禾。

異# different + 北 north → a region in northern China (now identified with *Hebei Province*) famed for a special breed of horse, 騏, which featured a distinctive (= different) square pattern on the hide, blue-black in color. *Hope* and *wish for* are borrowed meanings.
北方州也。从北異聲。

Originally, a depiction of a marker hung on a fence. The meanings *border* and *distant* suggest that the marker indicated a distant borderline, or border post. The relevant bronzeware inscription form adds an element indicating a particular place, creating the variant form 冋.
邑外謂之郊，郊外謂之野，野外謂之林，林外謂之冂。象遠界也。凡冂之屬皆从冂。
小兒蠻夷頭衣也。从冂；二，其飾也。凡冃之屬皆从冃。
毛冄冄也。象形。凡冄之屬皆从冄。
The relevant oracle bone form of this character is a roof + 入# (place inside) → place objects *inside/within* a storehouse → *home*; *put in*; *among*; *between*.

A depiction of a supple object, a soft, droopy beard (compare 而) → *tender*; *weak*. Also, *advance* (← advance slowly and steadily, like a growing beard). 冄 is a variant form of 冉. Distinguish from 再.

A depiction of a profusion of slender, inscribed bamboo slats of irregular length, bound with a cord → *book*; *counter* (for books/magazines etc.) (← bamboo and wood as writing mediums). Note a variant form 册.
符命也。諸矦進受於王也。象其札一長一短，中有二編之形。凡冊之屬皆从冊。
An abbreviated form# of 冓 (symmetrical construction; symmetry) + an additional line (at the top) indicating "another of the same" → *(once) again*; *twice*.
一舉而二也。从冓省。
An abbreviated form of 骨 (scoop out a limb from its joint) → *hollow/scoop out*. 咼 is a variant form of 冎.
剔人肉置其骨也。象形。頭隆骨也。凡冎之屬皆从冎。
A representation of a ventilation hole# (compare 向) + 八 split right and left → *bright* light streaming through a pair of ventilation holes made on opposite sides of a roof → *clear*.

Originally, 冃 as described in 冒 (cover) + a variant of 甲 (armor/helmet) → armor, including a *helmet*, running from the head to the waist. Eventually, under the influence of 胄, the top element morphed into the cognate (but etymologically distinct) 由#.

The relevant seal inscription form of 冐 is 目 eye + 冃# covered parallel lines → wrap a long blindfold around the head, covering the eyes. *Risk*, *brave* and *dare* are associated meanings (← blind attack, interpreted in a positive sense) → *have a bad effect on*; *damage* (← results of such an attack). In contemporary Japanese usage, 冐 has been supplanted by 冒.
冡而前也。从冃从目。
The relevant seal inscription form shows one of a pair of arching, symmetrical constructions (compare 高) → *assemble*.
交積材也。象對交之形。凡冓之屬皆从冓。
大夫以上冠也。邃延、垂瑬、紞纊。从冃免聲。古者黃帝初作冕。
A *cover* that conceals an object. Based on the ancient pronunciation of 冖, it in all likelihood derives from the top element of 冥.
覆也。从一下垂也。凡冖之屬皆从冖。

The relevant seal inscription form shows two curving lines serving as an abstract representation of the idea of movement through open space + 冖 cover → move through the open area of a covered space → *superfluity* (← space other than that necessary in which to move ). There is no etymological connection with 几.
淫淫，行皃。从人出冂。
飯剛柔不調相著。从皀冂聲。讀若適。
As per 元# (rounded/oval head) + an element combining 冖 cover and 寸 hand/action indicator → object placed on and adhering to the head → *crown*.
絭也。所以絭髮，弁冕之緫名也。从冂从元，元亦聲。冠有法制，从寸。
An abbreviated form# of 冃 as described in 冒 (cover) + 豕 pig/boar → thrust a cover on a downed pig/boar (compare 冢), concealing it → *cover*.
覆也。从𠔼、豕。

The lower element# is 豕 pig/boar + a line drawn through it → run a spear through a downed boar. 冢 adds 冖 cover → cover a downed pig/boar. *Mound* and *hillock* are via shape association with the massive form of a downed pig/boar → *burial mound*.
高墳也。从勹豖聲。
積也。从冂从取，取亦聲。

Effectively a variant form of 宛 (bend beneath a cover), the substitution of 兔 (variant form of 兎 rabbit) for the two bending figures in 宛 suggesting a rabbit crouching under the cover in which it is trapped → *be framed/falsely accused*.
屈也。从兔从冂。兔在冂下，不得走，益屈折也。

In its present form, 冖# cover + an element combining 日 sun/day + 六 (originally, 入 enter) → cover blocking the entry of sunlight → *darkness* → *the depths*; *the other world* (← unseen dimension). Also, *stupidity* (← dark ignorance). However, 冥 itself is likely the source of the 冖 element/character, suggesting that a different combination of elements conveyed the idea of darkness in the earliest form of 冥.
幽也。从日从六， 冖聲。日數十。十六日而月始虧幽也。凡冥之屬皆从冥。
幕# curtain + 冖 cover → *a cover*; *covering cloth*. *Exponent* is a borrowed meaning.
Originally, a depiction# of food tied to a cord that winds about a peg. A seal inscription form adds 氷 ice → *winter* (season when preserved/stored food is consumed). Compare 蓄.
四時盡也。从仌从夂。夂，古文終字。

鼕.explanation: 鼕 represents a drum-like onomatopoeic sound in differentiated traditional usage, not the season winter. 冬 remains unchanged for winter.
鼕.example: 冬天 → 冬天; 鼕鼕 (drum-sound word)
鼕.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 水堅也。从仌从水。
As per 互# (fit together) + 氷 ice → *freeze* (← fuse in freezing; compare 冴).
中# center/middle + 氷 ice → (crashing sound of a) block of ice being split down the middle. *Offshore*, *offing* and *open sea* are borrowed meanings via 沖 → *emptiness* (← empty spaces ← open sea).

沖.example: 冲茶 → 沖茶; 冲突 → 衝突

決.explanation: The 2013 mainland appendix places 決 in the orthographic-variant column for 决. 決 is a normal traditional-writing form in regions using traditional characters.
決.example: 决定 → 決定 (juédìng, regional traditional spelling)
決.usageCaveat: Do not label 決 as a traditional-column form under the 2013 mainland classification.
決.evidenceScope: 2013 Appendix 1 row 0523 verified; regional spellings can use a glyph that the mainland appendix classifies as an orthographic variant.

entries.text: As per 牙# (mesh; cross) + 氷 ice → biting *cold*; *freeze/freezing*. Also, *clear* (← cold, limpid sky).
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 氷 ice → heavy, *melting* block of ice → *smelting* (compare 鑠) → *knead into shape*.
銷也。从仌台聲。

As per 令# (long sequence) + 氷 ice → long stretch of ice → *cold*; *chilly*; *cool*. Other extended meanings include *refrigerate*, *cold-hearted* (compare 惏), *surly*, *calm* and *quiet*. *Tease* and *window shopping* are via the sense of taking a cool attitude toward a person/purchasing.
寒也。从仌令聲。
半# split + 氷 ice → ice that splits in melting → *melt*. Compare 泮.
一之日㓖冹。从仌犮聲。
As per 列# (painful stimulus) + 氷 ice → raw/*stinging cold*. Compare 凓.
A variant form of 淒 with 冫/氷 replacing 氵/水 and bearing the meanings *fierce*, *terrible*, *horrible* and *threaten*.
As per 固# (hardened object) + 氷 ice → *freeze*.

As per 隹# (exert downward pressure) + 氷 ice → sheet of ice flattening the surface below → *liken* (to); *accept* (← accepted standard ← level off to a standard ← flatten). *Quasi-* and *semi-* are borrowed meanings.

準.explanation: Use 準 for standard, accurate, or criterion senses; the inherited character 准 also remains in use in certain words such as 批准.
準.example: 标准 → 標準; 批准 → 批准
準.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

涼.explanation: The 2013 mainland standard places 涼 in the orthographic-variant column for 凉 rather than in its traditional-character column. The glyph 涼 remains common in traditional-script regions.
涼.example: 凉快 → 涼快 (traditional regional writing)
涼.usageCaveat: Retain the association but do not label it an official 2013 mainland traditional-character pair.
涼.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 寒也。从仌青聲。
As per 周# (grain plants) + 氷 ice → icy conditions causing (grain) plants to *droop*, *wither* and die → *fade*.
半傷也。从仌周聲。

As per 夌# as described in 陵 (stretch) + 氷 ice → thick wall of ice stretching skywards → *surpass* → *overcome*. Also, *icehouse* → *keep out/at bay*. *Insult*, *break a rule* and *commit a crime* are borrowed meanings.
As per 東# (run through) + 氷 ice → ice running through a given spot → *frozen over* → *freeze*; *chill*.
仌也。从仌東聲。
As per 栗# (sting) + 氷 ice → *shiver* with the *stinging cold*. Compare 冽.
寒也。从仌栗聲。
寒也。从仌倉聲。
流仌也。从仌斯聲。

As per 稟# (rows) + 氷 ice → row of icicles formed in *freezing* weather, causing shivering/trembling (compare 凓) → *severe* (← severe weather conditions). Also, *manly* (← severe personality ← severe weather). A variant form, 凛, replaces 禾 with 示 altar/the supernatural.

As per 疑# (come to a stop) + 氷 ice → flowing water coming to a stop in hardening into ice → *rigidity*; *concentration*; *stiff*. *Strain*, *be absorbed in*, *fix attention on* and *elaborate* (v.) are extended meanings.
A depiction of a tall *desk/table*.
踞几也。象形。《周禮》五几：玉几、雕几、彤几、䰍几、素几。凡几之屬皆从几。

entries.text: A depiction of a large piece of cloth such as a full-spread sail that encompasses the wind → *ordinary*; *common*; *general* (← cover things in general ← cover a wide area; compare 遍).
最括也。从二，二，偶也。从绅，绅，古文及。
處也。从尸得几而止。《孝經》曰：“仲尼凥。”凥，謂閒居如此。
止也。得几而止。从几从夂。
An abbreviated form of 風 wind + 巾 cloth → *kite*.
An abbreviated form of 風 wind + 木 tree → *wintry wind* (that denudes trees of their autumn leaves).
An abbreviated form of 風 wind + 止 stop → a *lull* (← no wind); a *calm*.
A variant form of 凴 *lean on/depend on*, with 任 substituted for the 馮 element.
依几也。从几从任。《周書》：“凭玉几。”讀若馮。
As per 皇# (ruler) + an abbreviated form of 風 wind (here suggesting a force blowing far and wide) → a mythical (female) bird regarded as the ruler of the avian world → female *phoenix*. Compare 鳳.

As per 豈# (pile of food) + 几 desk/table → food piled for a feast → *enjoy* → *relax* (← take one's ease at a feast). *Shouts/songs of triumph* is a borrowed meaning. 凱 was devised to express the original sense of 豈 after the latter underwent its transformation of meanings, but itself acquired other meanings.
As per 馮# (by means of) + 几 desk/table → stand with the assistance/by means of a piece of furniture → *lean/depend on* → *proof* (← evidence on which one can rely).
A depiction of a *hole/depression* or container in which something is encompassed or concealed.
張口也。象形。凡凵之屬皆从凵。
凵 hole + an indicator# suggesting a person or object → large, round cavity into which a person/object falls (compare 禍, 陷, and 俗) → *terrible*; *bad*; *disaster* → *poor harvest*.
惡也。象地穿交陷其中也。凡凶之屬皆从凶。
墣也。从土，一屈象形。
A depiction of an object with a protrusion rising from its center → *protrude*; *convex*. For "protrusion," compare 出 and 突.
A depiction of a concave object sunken in the middle due to pressure from above → *concave*; *indented*; *hollowed out*.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 屮# grass shoot + 土 earth → grass/bud/sprout protruding from the ground → *protrude*; *emerge*; *appear*; *go/come out* → *proceed*; *depart*; *start/leave*; *set forth*; *begin to*; *origin*; *hold/put out*; *break out*. Extended meanings from these basic ideas include *let out*; *take out*; *present* (for inspection); *turn on*; *give off*; *emit*; *express*; *submit*; *hand/send in*; *send*; *publish*; *issue*; *serve* (food/drinks); *give*; *hang (out)* (a flag); *open* (a business); *pay*; *flow*; *one's turn*; *be on duty*; *come out at*; *reach*; *arrive*; *attend*; *appearance*; *birth*; *be produced*; *be brought up*; *graduate* (from school); and *be in demand*. Also, *pretext* (← present an explanation ← present) and *answer* (a phone) (← appear on the receiving end of a call ← appear). *Soup stock* and *broth* are via the use of だし as an abbreviation of 出し汁 (だしじる). For "protrusion," compare 凸and 突.
進也。象艸木益滋，上出達也。凡出之屬皆从出。
The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines 凵# (container) + an arrow → place arrows inside a *box*/case → *place inside*.
